answer: Admission auction: each epoch offers 200 slots; the 200th bid sets the clearing price. A gale of fake filings only pushes it higher: to forge 1,000 identities costs 1,000 × 40 coins = 40,000 against a monthly pool of just 30,000. Winners lock bids for 20 epochs, and a public referral graph exposes star-shaped clusters for slashing. An honest agent buys one slot early, pays once, and keeps its full yield instead of feeding a bidding spiral.
